description:
Copy into the target filestore ONLY the files the carried attachments reference (generated
    css/js bundles and attachments of skipped records stay behind). Read-only on the source
    filestore (`source_filestore`, e.g. /var/lib/odoo/filestore/<db> - data_pump_plan prints it).
    Same box: rsync --files-from; two boxes: a tar of exactly those files relayed through this
    agent (sha256 checked). Ownership fixed for the target runtime. The sha1 of every file is
    proven by data_pump_verify. A file deleted from the live filestore after the copy was taken
    cannot be copied - it is counted, never silently skipped.
name: data_pump_files
